messages:
maria: kicking off feature-flag rollout `ff/session-affinity` -> stage 2 (10% prod-us-west). watch errors and p99, please. rollout id r-2026-03-15-01
deploy-bot: started rollout r-2026-03-15-01 -> 10% prod-us-west (agents: 4 nodes). logs: https://internal-logs/r-2026-03-15-01
tom: seeing a small bump in 500s on /api/v1/gen at ~+4m, rate ~1.8% now. not huge but trending up. @maria can you confirm the traffic split? :eyes:
alex: alert from incident-bot: ERROR_RATE /api/v1/gen > 2% for 3m in prod-us-west -> https://pager.link/ERR123 :pager:
incident-bot: opened incident INC-2026-0423-21 (auto-detected error-rate spike)
jamie: support pinged: a few paying customers reported increased latency and some 502s ~5:12pm PT. ticket refs: SUP-887, SUP-889
maria: can we pause or kill the flag? where's the kill switch. if error-rate > 2.5% we should stop and roll back to 0%
ops-oncall: the FF UI seems flaky on staging dashboard. trying API toggle now
jamie: heads-up — we have a partial dashboard for rollouts but the new "ff rollout view" never got provisioned in prod (looks like last deploy dropped the dashboard manifest). so current dashboards don't show per-flag p99, only global p99. :grimacing:
alex: that explains why on-call got only generic alerts. we don't have the per-flag SLO burn metric wired into the alerting rule for this rollout id
ops-oncall: toggling flag via API. running:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://internal-ff/api/flags/session-affinity/toggle' \
  -d '{"state":"off"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
ops-oncall: request sent, awaiting confirmation
deploy-bot: rollout r-2026-03-15-01 paused by ops-oncall at +6m
mar ia: (typo) maria: thanks — confirmed paused. can we do a quick canary rollback and restore traffic? Also need to surface customer impact to CS
support: we saw ~120 unique customer requests in 10m window; sev2 potential. Opening bridge for CS summary.
alex: paging confusion: some alerts went to infra-oncall, some to api-oncall; looks like the alert routing didn't include the new alert tag for rollout-id so oncall users were split. this delayed the kill by ~90s
tom: can we add a temporary routing rule to send rollout-* alerts to eng-oncall until dashboards restored?
ops-oncall: added a temporary route rule in pagerduty for tag: rollout:r-2026-03-15-01 -> eng-oncall. will expire in 1h. :white_check_mark:
jamie: cs summary for customers: "We identified an increase in errors during a feature flag rollout and throttled the flag; our engineering team paused the rollout and reverted the flag. If you experienced 5xx during 17:05-17:12 PT, this should be resolved. We're following up with root cause." please review
alex: postmortem notes: primary gaps: 1) dashboard manifest not deployed (prod missing per-flag metrics) 2) alert routing rules don't include rollout tags by default 3) FF UI reliance for kill switch with no fast API fallback 4) no emergency runbook for missing dashboard scenario
maria: agree. immediate action items: - restore missing dashboard manifest to prod (infra: deploy dashboard manifest) - add rollout tag to alert routing defaults (pagerduty) - add explicit kill-switch API healthcheck to runbooks
ops-oncall: creating follow-up tasks: TSK-334 (deploy dashboard manifest), TSK-335 (pagerduty routing change), TSK-336 (runbook update). assigning now
incident-bot: updated incident INC-2026-0423-21 with impact: ~120 customer reports, transient 5xx spike, rollback performed, no data loss. severity: P2
jamie: filing customer notes now, will send to affected accounts list.
alex: final note for handoff: handoff to next oncall at +1h. recommend watch for regressions and verify dashboard metrics are present before any future ff rollouts. :rocket:
